bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to animals; prohibiting animal testing under certain circumstances; providing for civil penalties; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 343.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[343.41] PROHIBITION ON COLUMN E-REPORTABLE ANIMAL RESEARCH PROCEDURES.

Subdivision 1.

Animals in research prohibited.

A research facility as defined in United States Code, title 7, section 2132, in Minnesota must not conduct any research, teaching, surgery, experiment, study, or test if the activity is or would be reportable to the United States Department of Agriculture on APHIS Form 7023, Column E, or APHIS Form 7023B (Column E Explanation), pursuant to United States Code, title 7, section 2143, and Code of Federal Regulations, title 9, section 236.

Subd. 2.

Application to certain activities.

This section does not apply to an activity required by federal law or regulation, including but not limited to Code of Federal Regulations, title 9, section 113.

Subd. 3.

Application to federal facilities.

This section does not apply to a federal research facility, as defined in United States Code, title 7, section 2132.

Sec. 2.

[343.42] PENALTIES.

Subdivision 1.

Animals in research prohibited; penalties.

A testing facility or research facility that conducts any research, teaching, surgery, experiment, study, or test in violation of section 343.41, subdivision 1, must pay an administrative penalty of $10,000 for each animal subjected to the violation.

Subd. 2.

Civil action; remedies.

In any judicial action for a violation according to this section in which the state has proven that the defendant's violation was willful, a court may order the defendant to reimburse the state an amount that the court determines is the reasonable value of litigation expenses incurred by the state. When determining the amount of litigation expenses to be reimbursed, the court must consider the economic circumstances of the defendant.
additions: [343.41] PROHIBITION ON COLUMN E-REPORTABLE ANIMAL RESEARCH PROCEDURES.

A research facility as defined in United States Code, title 7, section 2132, in Minnesota must not conduct any research, teaching, surgery, experiment, study, or test if the activity is or would be reportable to the United States Department of Agriculture on APHIS Form 7023, Column E, or APHIS Form 7023B (Column E Explanation), pursuant to United States Code, title 7, section 2143, and Code of Federal Regulations, title 9, section 236.
This section does not apply to an activity required by federal law or regulation, including but not limited to Code of Federal Regulations, title 9, section 113.
This section does not apply to a federal research facility, as defined in United States Code, title 7, section 2132.

A testing facility or research facility that conducts any research, teaching, surgery, experiment, study, or test in violation of section 343.41, subdivision 1, must pay an administrative penalty of $10,000 for each animal subjected to the violation.

In any judicial action for a violation according to this section in which the state has proven that the defendant's violation was willful, a court may order the defendant to reimburse the state an amount that the court determines is the reasonable value of litigation expenses incurred by the state. When determining the amount of litigation expenses to be reimbursed, the court must consider the economic circumstances of the defendant.
